selection: minimum canonical original-record mean raw CE; improvement greater than 1e-10, bank-order ties
context: retain the reviewed CM42 selected neighborhood and every original context row
diagnostic: same CM42 canonical margin24 raw-label votes and original record multiplicity, excluding the queried observed input state
independence: uses original training inputs and labels only, never trained coefficients or held-out targets
caveat: latent discovery and context selection use all training data; no leave-one-out discovery refit or held-out accuracy guarantee
applicability: only the reviewed context rows that interpolate an unobserved ambiguous matched input
unmodified_rows: observed inputs, unique-label blocks, unmatched cells and unknown axes retain exact original logits
implementation: multiply actual complex context features by the fixed positive scale before the unchanged full coefficient dot product
training: original ordinary CE and exact original batches; zero extra optimizer updates
raw_ranking: positive scale preserves exact-real raw ranking for a fixed context map; floating-point and pooled metrics measured afresh
